gallery.description: There are numerous events scheduled for the end of October 2025 in Bradford, including theater performances, music, Halloween-themed activities, and cultural exhibitions as part of the UK City of Culture celebrations.

gallery.title: File:Bradford, West Yorkshire (129^) - Flickr - Cardinator25.jpg
gallery.description: Bradford's 2025 UK City of Culture year is widely considered a huge success, marked by over 3 million attendees, significant economic boosts, widespread community participation (87,000+ people), increased tourism, revitalized cultural venues (like Cartwright Hall), and a major sense of local pride, culminating in a massive, well-attended closing event in December 2025.
